details.description: Mr. Olympia is an annual International bodybuilding contest held by the International Federation of Bodybuilding and Fitness (IFBB). Joe Weider and Ben Weider created IFBB way back in 1946. The very first Mr. Olympia event was held in 1965 and since then it has become a symbol of excellence and achievement. Moreover, My Fitness became the first Indian brand to become the presenting sponsor of Mr. Olympia in 2021. An addition to our range of products is the all-new 'Olympia Limited Edition' Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter with added Everyday Whey protein. Available in delectable dark chocolate flavours in 3 textures - crunchy, smooth and crispy. High Protein Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter has been carefully crafted for fitness enthusiasts and gym aficionados (gym-goers). We bet no one can ever get enough of this flawless invention. The deliciousness of dark chocolate combined with the goodness of all-natural roasted peanuts and whey protein makes this product the ideal addition to any diet. Rich in fibre and protein, with NO trans fat, what more can one ask for?

Designed with an advanced formulation, this peanut butter reduces oil separation by up to 99%, ensuring a smooth, ready-to-eat experience. No more stirring—just open the jar and enjoy a consistent, easy-to-spread high protein peanut butter every time.

For those who love texture, MyFitness Peanut Butter Classic Zero delivers an extra crunchy experience with more peanut bits in every scoop. This nut butter offers the perfect balance of creaminess and crunch, making it more satisfying than regular spreads.

Packed with 28g of peanut protein per 100g, this high protein peanut butter supports muscle recovery and daily energy needs. Whether it’s post-workout or part of your routine, this peanut butter protein source helps you stay active and energized.
ZERO TRANS FAT & ZERO CHOLESTEROL
Made for mindful eating, MyFitness Peanut Butter Classic Zero contains zero trans fats and zero cholesterol, making it a heart-friendly choice. It’s a smart addition to your diet if you’re looking for a balance of taste and nutrition.
VERSATILE & DELICIOUS
More than just a spread, the MyFitness Peanut Butter Classic Zero fits into your lifestyle effortlessly. Spread it on toast, blend it into smoothies, mix it into oats, or enjoy it straight from the jar—just like homemade peanut butter, but more convenient and consistent.
PERFECT BALANCE OF HEALTH & TASTE
